RESOLUTION NO. 78-29
RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF SAN JOSE APPROVING A FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT AS COMPLETE FOR A PROJECT DESCRIBED IN APPLICATION NO. PP 78-10 AND FINDING THAT SAID PROJECT WILL NOT HAVE A SIGNIFICANT EFFECT ON THE ENVIRONMENT.
WHEREAS, pursuant to Article XX of the San Jose Municipal Code
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF SAN JOSE:
City of San Jose
hereinafter referred to as "Applicant", on February, 1978 filed
Application No. PP 78-10 for a final Environmental Impact
Report on his proposed project, in the manner set forth in said
application, of that certain real property, hereinafter referred to
as "subject property", described in Exhibit "A" attached hereto and
made a part hereof by reference as though fully set forth herein; and
WHEREAS, the Director of Planning, pursuant to and in accordance
with said Article has prepared and filed with this Commission a

WHEREAS, pursuant to and in accordance with said Article, the Director of Planning did send a copy of said draft Report to each public agency having jurisdiction by law of said proposed project, advising such agencies to review and submit written comments, if any, to this Commission in the time and manner specified in said Article; and
